tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i tho yig nyin byed snang ba la brten nas gri gug lha lnga sin+dhu ra la brten pa snyan brgyud lugs dang mgon po lha bcu bdun gyi dbang gi phyag len zur 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gur gyis mgon po lha bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i tho yig nyin byed snang bar bcu gnyis ma dang lha lnga'i dbang chog gsal la/ lha brgyad ni sgo ma bzhi dor ba ma gtogs gzhan 'dra'o/ /man ngag lugs kyi sin+dhu ra la brten pa'i gri gug lha lnga ma la chog dbang gong ma rnams dang bcas pa ga ya dha ra nas brgyud lugs la sbyor ba'i skabs su gri gug lha lnga'i rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du maṇ+ḍal la sin+dhu ras byugs te dbus su gri gug gcig bris pa'i lte ba yangs pa'i gung du hūm̐/ shar du bh+ruṃ/ lhor aṃ/ nub tu dz+rīṃ/ byang du khaṃ bris/ de'i mtha' skor du yi ge bdun ma/ de'i mtha' skor du bcu gnyis ma/ de'i mtha' skor du shā sa na/ de'i mtha' mar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis kā li so bzhi/ mdun nas g.yon skor gyi ā li bcu drug ste/ thams cad kyi yig mgo phyir bstan par bris la dar gyis lding gur phub pa'am ma 'byor yang chog dbang gi mtha' brten skabs su slob ma la bka' bsgo byed na/ gtor ma de la mda' dar dang / mgon po'i tsakli yod na'ang btsugs/ sku'i rjes gnang la sku dang / gsung la bzlas lung byed pas dbang rdzas mi dgos thugs la lcags kyu rdo rje rtse dgu pa'am/ gri gug gang rung / yon tan la gaṇ+ḍe/ 'di lha bcu bdun ma gtogs dbang bka' bzhi ka la dgos so// dngos grub la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rjes gnang la mi rkang gi gling bu dang /

stag lpags sogs yod na bshams/ med na dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rjes gnang tsakli sogs ras kyis rung / gzhan mchod gtor bsham pa sogs 'dra/ bdag mdun gyis lha bskyed mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ mdun bskyed kyi tshe sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa lha lngar bskyed/ bum pa rnam rgyal du mgon po lha lnga bskyed pa dang / las bum 'khyil pa ste dbang bka' lnga ka la 'dra/ 'dir dbang gi skabs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang / 'jug pa nas bum dbang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs pa'i bar kyai rdor lam dbang dang 'dra la/ cung zad mi 'dra ba deng khyod nag po chen po thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi zhes dang / nag po chen po deng khyod sogs dang / ye shes dbab pa sogs gri gug lha lnga rgya gzhung dang 'dra/ rig pa'i dbang lnga kyai rdor dang 'dra la/ mtha' brten rjes gnang skabs su mgon po'i 'bur sku'am/ tsakli rab gnas can slob ma'i spyi bor khyed la rdo rje'am dam tshig gi phyag rgya sku'i spyi bor bzhag yi ge bdun pa'i rjes la sa mā ya smra ra sogs nas rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a mo gha badz+ra/ pad+ma badz+ra/ in+t+ra bhu ti/ phun tshogs bde ba nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se mkhar chung pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ sa skya pa chen po/ rdze btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar ba rdo rje 'od zer/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ rong mi ye shes/ trā+e bo rdo rje grags/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang pa theg chen chos rgyal/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / mnyam med dpal 'dzin bzang po/

thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar bstan pa bsrungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung skyabs sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ gsung gi rjes gnang la gtso bo'i sngags gsum gyi bzlas lung sbyin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'am gri gug rab gnas can lag pa g.yas par gtad de/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rten/ /gang gis 'phyar ba tsam gyis ni/ /gdug pa rdul du rlog byed pa/ /de ring khyed la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ shrī ka la ye badz+ra karta ri ya bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gaṇ+ḍe rab gnas can lag par gtad de/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rten/ /gang gis bsnun pa tsam gyis ni/ /pho nya las la bskul byed pa/ /de ring sogs/ oṃ shrī nas badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ thod pa chang gis gang ba lag pa g.yon par gtad de/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dngos grub rten/ /gang gis bcangs pa tsam gyis kyang / nag po dges pas ngom byed pa/ /de ring sogs/ oṃ shrī nas/ badz+ra ka pā la/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ slob ma'i rkang 'og tu ro gdan bris pa'am bcos pa/ sked par stag sham dngos sam bris pa/ lus dang yan lag tu rus rgyan/ lag tu mi rkang gi gling bu rnams gtad de/ gdug pa 'dul phyir ro yi gdan/ /de bzhin stag sham dpa' bo'i chas/

/kun 'bod dung chen gling bu'i sgras/ /zil gyis gnon byed phyag rgya drug /'jigs byed chen po'i chas rnams kyis/ /de ring khyed la dbang bskur bas/ /mgon po'i 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /thams cad 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog /oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ya ka la waka tsit+ta gu na karma a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gtor dbang ni 'dir mi dgos/ dbang bka' gzhan la byed na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod de bka' bsgo bya/ deng sang gri gug lha lnga rgya gzhung lugs la mdzad gzhan la ni rgyun du mi mdzad/ bslab bya ni/ khyed rnams kyi sku'i dam tshig tu mgon po rgyun tu mchod gsung gi dam tshig tu bsnyen pa la brtson pa dang / thugs gyi dam tshig tu bsgrub pa dang / las la sbyar te/ bstan pa bsrung / sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod/ sin+dhu ra'i yig 'bru rnams kyi phyi log nas blangs te srin lag g.yon pas slob ma'i dpral bar byugs te yi ge bdun pa brjod/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum dbang brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyis sin dhu ra'i 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /gsang dbang zhu ba ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po sogs kyi gsol ba btab lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i byang sems dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba de ljags thog tu phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs bdud rtsi ste/ slob ma a ho su khaḥbarjod/ mgrin pa'i ya ra la wa'i rtsa bzhi nas brgyud/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su 'gag te/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

'bru gsum gyi mig dar dkrol/ sin dhu ra'i yig 'bru rnams la srin lag g.yon pas blangs te slob ma'i mgrin par byugs/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang dbang rten par byas pa'i sogs/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyis gsang dbang thob/ lam rang byin gyi rlabs pa dang / lta ba rang byung gi ye shes skyong ba la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku sogs/ shes rab dbang la maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab mig dar rnams sngar bzhin/ dga' ster gnas ster sogs tshigs bcad kyi phyag rgya gtad/ bshang lci dag ni sogs kyis dri ba dri lan/ thabs shes snyom 'jug dga' bzhi nyams su myang ba'i bar lam dus bzhin 'bru gsum gyis mig dar bkrol/ sin+dhu ra'i phyag mtshan srin lag gis blangs te snying khar byugs te/ thugs kyis byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang brtan par/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa dang / lta ba lhan skyes skyong ba la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i nus pa sogs dbang bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab/ mig dar/ ye shes 'di ni nas mig dar bkrol ba'i bar lam dus bzhin/ ka pā la nas bdud rtsi lan gsum mam gcig sbyin la/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyis dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa dang / lta ba mas brtan gyi lhan skyes skyong ba la dbang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rjes gtso bos sogs 'dra/ rjes chog ras bris brtan bzhugs dang / sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs pa sogs bya'o// ༈ /lha bcu bdun ma'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la/ bdag mdun lha bskyed gzhal yas khang rdzogs par bskyed nas/ byang ljang ba'i bar 'dra/ de nas 'og gi sa gzhi rdo rje'i brag nag nag pos gtam pa'i steng na/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mthing gri gug gis rwa bas bskor ba/

de'i dbus gru gsum la zhing gnyis bsnol ba'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ rtsibs brgyad la nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus su hūm̐ las nag po chen po sngar bzhin bskyed/ 'on kyang g.yas gri gug 'phyar thabs dang / g.yon thod khrag thugs khar gaṇ+ḍe med/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ngo / /rtsibs brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad las g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin/ gshin rje pho nya mo dang / mche ba mo dang / be con mo dang / dus mtshan mo dang / lcag kyu mo dang / zhags pa mo dang / lcags sgrog mo dang / 'bebs ma ste ma mo brgyad g.yas na gri gug 'phyar ba'i tshul/ g.yon pas thod khrag stobs pa'i tshul/ de'i phyi rim brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad las shar phyogs su ya ba ti/ lho phyogs su chos kyi rgyal po/ nub phyogs su tel pa/ byang phyogs su glang mgo can/ byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu/ nub byang du gshin rje rmig pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje phya sangs/ shar lhor mig dmar thabs cad kha dog sngo skya/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba'i tshul/ g.yon thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin pa/ gshin rje pho mo kun kyang stag lpags rlon pas smad dkris pa/ khro zhing spyan gsum pa dmar la zlum pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sku la sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku la rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa// ༈ /ras bris la gshin rje mo rnams rtsib brgyad kyi nang rim dang / pho rnams de'i rgyab kyi phyi rim la yod na'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin bskyed brgyud dur khrod nag po'i 'gril ba sogs las bshad pas/ lugs tshad ldan gcig go/ ༈ /yang bri cha 'ga' zhig la gshin rje pho mo mnyam sbyor du bris pa yang 'dug pas/ de bzhin du byed na/ rtsibs brgyad la pad nyi'i steng du ya dang ma rnams las shar du gshin rje ya ba ti dang / gshin rje pho nya mo gnyis yab yum zhal sbyor/ lhor gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje che ba mo gnyis yab yum/

nub tu gshin rje tel pa gshin rje be con ma gnyis/ byang du gshin rje glang mgo can dang gshin rje lcag skyu ma dang zhal sbyor/ byang shar du gshin rje ral pa tshar dgu dang gshin rje dus mtshan mo gnyis zhal sbyor/ nub byang du gshin rje rmig pa dang gshin rje zhags pa ma gnyis zhal sbyor/ lho nub tu gshin rje phya sangs dang lug gu brgyud ma gnyis/ shar lho gshin rje mig dmar dang 'bebs ma gnyis yab yum gnyis zhal sbyor te/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil pa/ lus la rgyan cha med pa/ sbrul nag po se ral khar thog pa/ ha ha zhes khro bo'i sgra chen po sgrog shing / zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brgyangs bas me rlung dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ yum thams cad sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la stobs pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ yab kyi lce 'jib pa/ gdug pa thams cad tshul bzhin du 'gugs ma/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs bas yab kyi g.yon brkyangs pa dang gshib pa/ g.yon gyis yab kyi g.yas la 'khril zhing gnyis su med par bzhugs pa/ 'di dam pa kun dga' grags kyis lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub yig dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gter du bshad// ༈ /yang dkyil thang 'ga' rer gshin rje pho mo rnams rtsib rnams la g.yas g.yon du zhal g.yas gzigs g.yon gzigs su 'byung ngo / /lugs srol gang ltar yang / gnas gsum byin gyi rlabs lha bcu bdun gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstims/ dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bas lha thams cad la 'phrin las kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan byin gyi rlabs la/ phyi mchod sngar bzhin/

nang mchod la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs dran par byas la/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ grub chen nag po ro 'dzin/ lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar/ khams pa tshar dgu ston pa/ grub thob bsod nams grags/ bla ma mon mig dmar ston/ bla ma zhang chung ba/ lang gro dbang phyug dar/ lce ston mdo sde seng ge dpal chen skye med jo gdan/ gru ston shākya 'bum/ dge bshes dbugs/ bla ma dharma gzi brjid/ nyi thog pa kun dga' zla ba/ mdar mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ba/ pha rgod chos rje brag thog pa/ sngags 'chang 'jigs med dpa' bo/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun bsod/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sam/ bsdu na/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi zhal du༞ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ye/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du༞ gzhan yang lha chen brgyad la sogs pa nas/ rigs drug gi bar du'ang sbyin/ rang gi lcer yang myangs/ gtso bo la srin gzugs kyis bstod/ 'khor rnams la/ thabs mkhas snang stong sgyu ma'i gar/ /mi sdug khro bo'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /rngam pas dgra bo rdul du rlog /gshin rje'i gtso bo brgyad la bstod/ /shes rab bde stong khro mo'i sku/ /bgegs kun tshar gcod gri gug 'phyar/ /sgrub la brtse bas thod khrag bsnams/ /ma mo'i gtso mo brgyad la bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas yi dam gyi gtor ma dkyus bzhin dang / mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas la gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/

gtso bo shā sa tshar gsum/ gtso 'khor kun la thun mong du/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ye/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yaḥ sogs lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'bul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa mdor bsdus bya/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma yang gtong thub na legs rdo rje'i glu bkra shis rnams spyi ltar bzlas pa byed spro na de wa pi tsu nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar/ yi ge bdun pa shā sa na ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ lha lnga rgya gzhung lugs dang cha 'dra bar bdag 'jug blangs/ de nas slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs dang / 'dir mgon po lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing / dbang bskur ba la zhes sogs mtshams sbyar la/ da zod nas slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub/ slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab rgyun bshags mig dar/ me tog gtad pa bgegs bsang ba/ nang gi sems bskyed la brten par bya ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du gzhug pa phyag bya ba/ ye shes dbab pa/ me tog dor/ mig dar bkrol/ lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs ltar lha ngo bstan/ dngos gzhi'i ched du maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab/ slob ma dang / dbang rdzas/ bum pa cod paṇa sogs/ thugs kyi mgon po sogs rigs so sor bskyed la/ rig dbang lnga bskur/ drug pa brtul shugs kyi dbang sbyin/ mtha' rten sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang rnams mgon po'i sku sogs dbang rdzas so so dang bstun/ tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas ster ba sngar gyi rigs 'gre nas shes par bya'o/ /rjes gtso bos sogs 'dra/ de ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma nas gzung rjes chog gi bar cho ga'i chings gong bcu gnyis ma'i dkyil chog bzhin no/ /mgon po'i dbang 'di nyan pa'i slob ma ni kyai rdor/ de min na'ang bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung zhugs te smin dbang thob pa zhig dgos so/

/smras pa/ gzhung mang klag chog nyid du ma bkod pa/ /gong ma'i gsung rab mi nub bya phyir dang / /yi ge'i tshogs kyi ngal ba spang phyir yin/ /mdor bsdus 'di yis bstan 'gro'i don grub shog /dkyus gcig la byed na slob ma sta gon gcig pu des chog par mdzad/ dbang bka' re re tsam so sor byed na dngos sta tshang ma byas na legs/ gri gug lha lnga ma gtogs gzhan la sta gon ma byas kyang rung zer ba'ang 'dug sta gon gyi rmi lam brtags pa gnyid log pa'i dmigs pa byas nas dngos gzhi dang sbrel ba'i lugs kyang mthong ngo / /des na phyogs gcig la a 'thas mi byed par 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang shākya'i dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod du bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bur gyur pa rma khams pa shes rab lhun grub kyis bgyis pa'o/ /'di'i dge bas dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/ pṛts+tsha shad+dha// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gri gug lha lnga sin+dhu ra la brten pa snyan brgyud lugs sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
